roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier Skilled Nursing Facility in Oakland, MD. This vital role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, providing an excellent opportunity for a skilled professional to make a significant impact on staff competency and patient safety.

In this dual role, you will be responsible for coordinating staff education and development programs, ensuring all team members are equipped with the necessary skills and knowledge. Additionally, you will lead our infection control initiatives, developing and implementing policies to prevent and manage infections within the facility. Your expertise will be crucial in maintaining a safe and compliant environment for both residents and staff.

If you are an experienced Registered Nurse with a passion for education and infection prevention, we encourage you to apply. This full-time position offers a chance to contribute to a supportive team dedicated to high-quality care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience as a Staff Development Coordinator or in a similar training role
Experience in Infection Control within a healthcare setting
Knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42, based on experience.
